title: The Descent
description: One descent, fifteen palettes. The story runs from a map room on
the surface to the End and the dream of the way home, and every
stratum of it is one of the fifteen themes this build ships --
every one but `default`, which is the book's own frame rather
Each chapter is the same six stations -- the arrival, the path,
the ward, the hazard, the treasure, the way on -- at the same
coordinates, in the same shapes, at the same sizes. Click between
the chapters and a difference you see is the theme and nothing
else. That is what makes this group the way to compare them:
The chapters are LINEAR, so the chapter's own list is the
progression and no quest here carries a `dependsOn`.
